selection.basis: The fresh priority-sorted report puts the two published LightCarbon SPEEDZ variants at the top with 17 displayed gap entries covering 20 atomic gap instances: six shared platform facts apply to both variants, while their selected build, image and purchase-route facts remain variant-specific. Existing evidence is dated 2026-08-08 through 2026-09-24, so this recheck is limited to current exact-model manufacturer/catalog and exact configuration evidence.
selection.not_selected: The price field is not in scope: these variants have dated observed-price evidence and no current price gap in the fresh inventory.

targets.exact_identity: LightCarbon SPEEDZ road frame/platform; do not transfer geometry or construction claims from LCROX-D, LCR015-D or other model codes.
targets.evidence_only_assignment: one Luna Max agent researches this one exact model, sequentially and without repository edits; root owns all data integration.
evidence_order: Current exact-model LightCarbon product and 2025–26 catalog routes; record access failures without implying a specification is absent.
Current exact mainland model/configuration listing for selected wheels, tires, cockpit, and complete-bike weight; keep selected listing facts distinct from manufacturer defaults.

Exact-model visual routes; add or replace an image only when exactness, credit, alt text, source and usable rights/fallback are established. Keep third-party imagery remote unless reusable rights are documented.

research_rules.price_acceptance: Price is excluded because current price is not a fresh inventory gap. Never let a related SPEEDZ price resolve a different package or selected build.
research_rules.unknowns: Retain unknown, conflicted, inaccessible, or rights-limited facts with a dated attempt and a specific reason; do not transfer adjacent model claims.
research_rules.image_safety: Do not download, rehost, or copy third-party files without documented reusable rights; preserve exactness, credit, alt text, source and fallback metadata.
research_rules.stop_criteria: For each selected field, stop at exact credible evidence or the first decisive access, package, model-identity, or image-rights boundary. Do not repeat the prior 50-area sweeps.
research_rules.delivery: Local B50 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
